breaks.label: Série A pause — state championship finals
breaks.notes: Serie A stopped after 26 Feb for the knockout stages of the state championships -- Paulista, Carioca, Mineiro and Gaucho finals were all on 8 Mar. Back 11 Mar. Serie B had not started (21 Mar).

breaks.label: International break — March
breaks.notes: FIFA window 23-31 Mar. Serie A was off 23-28 Mar and played again on 29 Mar, inside the window; Serie B was off until 31 Mar.

breaks.label: World Cup pause — Série A
breaks.notes: World Cup 2026 (USA, Canada, Mexico), 11 Jun-19 Jul. Serie A stopped after 31 May and resumed 16 Jul, before the final. Serie B played straight through June and July.

breaks.label: International break — Sep/Oct (Série A)
breaks.notes: FIFA's merged 16-day window runs 21 Sep-6 Oct. Serie A is off 21 Sep-1 Oct and resumes 2 Oct, while the window is still open. Serie B plays straight through.

breaks.label: International break — November
breaks.notes: FIFA window 9-17 Nov. Serie A is off 7-17 Nov and resumes 18 Nov. Serie B is off 7-13 Nov and plays its final regular round on 14 Nov; its promotion play-offs follow on 21 and 28 Nov.
